intro.title: A trusted link in the global healthcare chain
intro.body: Founded in 2012 and operating as Al Qabas Pharmacy L.L.C since 2018, we are a dynamic pharmaceutical wholesale distributor based in Muscat. We connect manufacturers, governments and medical institutions with the medicines and solutions they need, backed by a senior leadership team with more than 30 years of combined industry experience.

keyFactors.title: Five reasons healthcare providers rely on us

items.title: Comprehensive product portfolio
items.body: We import and export a wide spectrum of pharmaceuticals, from branded and generic medicines to vaccines, plus specialised access programmes, reference-listed drugs and hard-to-source medications.

items.title: Wide clientele
items.body: We serve pharmacies, private hospitals, clinics, government health departments, NGOs, distributors and manufacturers across the Middle East and Africa.

items.title: Full-scale surgical and medical supplies
items.body: Medical devices, lab and surgical consumables, radiology, cardiac implants, diagnostics, environmental disinfection supplies and hospital maintenance services.

items.title: Regulatory excellence
items.body: Fully licensed and regulated by the Omani Ministry of Health, with robust quality control, strict compliance with international standards and integrity across our supply chain.

items.title: Global sourcing expertise
items.body: Specialists in international procurement and distribution, including unlicensed and special-supply medicines, comparator sourcing for clinical trials and managed-access programmes.

services.title: Two divisions, one standard of care

problemSolution.problemBody: Healthcare providers in developing regions often face critical shortages of essential, rare or specialised medicines. Weak supply chains, regulatory barriers and limited sourcing options lead to delays, stock-outs and inflated prices.
problemSolution.solutionBody: We source a wide range of high-quality pharmaceuticals, including hard-to-find and unregistered items, through trusted global partners. Our logistics network and regulatory expertise deliver timely solutions so hospitals, pharmacies and clinics can keep serving patients without interruption.
problemSolution.quote: We don’t just supply medicine. We bridge the gap where others can’t.

ceo.quote: Our journey is driven by a simple yet powerful purpose: to improve lives through reliable access to quality healthcare products. From regulatory compliance to global sourcing, from local partnerships to regional distribution, our team works to ensure every product we deliver upholds the highest standards of safety and effectiveness.

hero.title: Built on trust, driven by care

about.story: Founded in 2012 and operating as Al Qabas Pharmacy L.L.C since 2018, we are a dynamic pharmaceutical wholesale distributor based in Muscat, Oman. Backed by over 30 years of combined industry experience among our senior leadership, we have built a solid reputation for trust, reliability and personalised service. Al Qabas Pharmacy is licensed and regulated by the Omani Ministry of Health and fully committed to the quality of our products, the integrity of our supply chain and the highest levels of regulatory compliance.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To be a trusted partner in healthcare, known for excellence, integrity and positive impact on health and wellness.

mission.title: Mission
items: Enhance healthcare access by supplying high-quality pharmaceutical products and medical solutions to communities locally and internationally, with reliable, affordable and compliant products tailored to diverse healthcare needs.

Bridge the gap between global manufacturers and regional healthcare providers through efficient sourcing, timely delivery and customised service, so every product we deliver contributes to patient care and health outcomes.
Let innovation, integrity and responsiveness guide our daily operations as we improve our processes, expand our portfolio and invest in regulatory excellence.
Build long-term relationships with clients and partners, rooted in transparency, mutual respect and shared success in advancing healthcare across borders.
